meta.name: add-deltachat
meta.description: Add DeltaChat channel integration via @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge. Email-based messaging with end-to-end encryption.

copy.tagline: 通过 DeltaChat 集成加密邮件通信
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加端到端加密的邮件聊天功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate encrypted email messaging via DeltaChat
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add end-to-end encrypted email chat to your app

howto.what: 新增DeltaChat邮件聊天通道:机器人能通过DeltaChat收发加密电子邮件,支持附件、邀请链接/二维码、头像设置,并在群聊中按名称被提及响应。
howto.when: 服务启动时若检测到DeltaChat凭据,适配器自动启用;当用户通过DeltaChat私聊或群聊发消息,或群聊中提及机器人名称时,消息会交给已绑定的代理。

say.text: 帮我整理这封邮件,列出重点

howto.what_en: Adds a DeltaChat email chat channel: the bot can send/receive encrypted email messages via DeltaChat, supports attachments, invite link/QR avatar setting, and responds when addressed by name in groups.
howto.when_en: On startup, if DeltaChat credentials are detected, the adapter enables automatically; when a user sends a message via DeltaChat DM or group, or mentions the bot by name in a group, the message is routed to the bound agent.

say_en.text: Hi, what's on my schedule today?
Summarize this conversation into action items.
say_en.note: Message is handled by the bound agent.

say_en.text: Set this image as my avatar.
